title: Ideal unlimited contrast does not survive arbitrary leakage or closed stock
statement: At protected I=.02, 10,000 reference pulses with .1s idle have zero conversion only for ideal zero bypass and replenishment, consuming676.6898420 local inhibitor equivalents. Nonzero leakage gives -log(1-X_off)=gamma*ell*integral R_off; the reference1% limit needs ell<=4.950734802e-6. Without supply, inhibitor exhausts during pulse15. These are introduced sensitivities and stock accounts, not measured selectivity or a universal chemistry obstruction.
